criticism: The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. This can lead to a potential trap due to overflow of the 'balances[_to] += _value' expression. This can be mitigated by using a safe math library or adding a check to ensure that the addition does not overflow.

The transferFrom function also has an integer overflow vulnerability. This can lead to a potential trap due to overflow of the 'balances[_to] += _value' expression. This can be mitigated by using a safe math library or adding a check to ensure that the addition does not overflow.

The withdrawForeignTokens function has an access control vulnerability. This can lead to unauthorized withdrawal of foreign tokens. This can be mitigated by adding a modifier to restrict access to the function.

The getStats function has an access control vulnerability. This can lead to unauthorized access to contract's vital variables. This can be mitigated by adding a modifier to restrict access to the function.
The constructor has a typo vulnerability. This can lead to attackers acquiring tokens for free. This can be mitigated by correcting the constructor.
